firmware.title: Diablo
firmware.author: Mikhail Matveev; DevilutionX
firmware.description: Blizzard's 1996 action RPG on DevilutionX 1.5.5 at 640x480, HDMI sound, 504 MHz. Needs DIABDAT.MPQ or spawn.mpq in /diablo.
firmware.controls: USB mouse and keyboard as on the PC: click to walk and attack, Esc: menu.
